（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. B. REGISTRY / 2554/1H / 2a Station）
Date January 4. 1933.
Subject (in full) Communist Meeting in Western Chapel.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by D.S.G. Lovest.

With reference to the endorsement of the Officer
i/c Special Branch on the attached report, I have to state
that information concerning this particular communist meeting
held in Western Chapel on December 25 was given direct to the
undersigned by Agents Nos. 56710 and 56711.
The following is a description of Tsoong Chia Tsing
( 鐘家慶 ) who was reported to hav□ided over the meeting :-
Age 32; height 5' 5"; native of Paoying, North Kiangsu;
sallow complexion; usually dressed in blue cotton long gown.
He is an ex-worker of the N.W.K. No.6 and Dong Shing Cotton
Mills and has no fixed abode, but occasionally visits the
Dong Shing Cotton Mill Workers' Dormitory at No.101 Macao Road.
Particulars regarding this person have been recorded by this
office for future reference.
Kuh Tao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 特别巡捕房登记处 / 2554/1H / 2a分站）
日期：1933年1月4日。
事由（全称）：西堂共产党会议。
呈报人：侦探长顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）。转呈人：副总监乐福斯特（Lovest）。

兹就随附报告中特别巡捕房主管警官的批注而言，本人须声明，关于12月25日在西堂举行的此次特定共产党会议的情报，系由第56710号和第56711号线人直接提供给具名人的。
以下是对据报主持该会议的钟家庆（Tsoong Chia Tsing）的描述：
年龄32岁；身高5英尺5英寸；江苏北部宝应县人；面色枯黄；通常身穿蓝色棉长衫。他曾是西北针织厂第六厂和东兴纱厂的前工人，无固定住所，但偶尔会前往澳门路101号的东兴纱厂工人宿舍。
本办事处已记录此人的详细资料，以备将来查考。
顾道华（Kuh Tao-hwa）
侦探长

特别巡捕房主管警官。

File No.

Special Branch D. I. Station X
Date December 28, 1932.

Subject (in full) Communist Meeting in Western Chapel.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

SECRET
SECRET
SECRET
SECRET

At a meeting attended by twelve members of the Shanghai
Western District Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
in a straw hut in the rear of the Yung Yui (永豫) Cotton
Mill, Kwong Foh Road (光復路), Chapel, between 8 a.m.
and 9.30 a.m. December 25, 1932, the following resolutions
were passed :-

1) That the workers of each factory in Western District appoint
a representative to work with the Publication Department
of the Western District Committee.

2) That a special group of 80 persons be organized for the
purpose of dealing with Yellow Labour Unions and those
members of the Kuomintang engaged in shadowing work by
using "choppers" and "hand grenades".

3) That arrangements be made for the celebration of the
resumption of Sino-Soviet relations by the holding
of demonstrations (time and venue not stated).

The meeting was presided over by one Tsoong Chia Tsing
(鐘家俊), an unemployed worker, who was formerly employed
by the Dong Shing Cotton Mill, 181 Gordon Road.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

S2. The names of the detectives and
the number of the agent through which this
information came should be given. Please
endeavour to obtain a photograph and
description of Tsong Chia Tsing. Where does
he reside?
A.D. Kuh. Off. Stn. X 28:12:'32.

日期：1932年12月28日。

事由（全称）：西堂共产党会议。

呈报人：侦探长顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa） 转呈人：[签名]

秘密
秘密
秘密
秘密

1932年12月25日上午8时至9时30分之间，在光复路永豫（Yung Yui）纱厂后方的一间草棚内，举行了一次有中国共产党上海西区委员会十二名成员参加的会议，会上通过了以下决议：

1) 西区各工厂的工人指派一名代表，与西区委员会出版部协同工作。

2) 组织一个由80人组成的特别小组，目的是通过使用“斧头”和“手榴弹”来对付黄色工会以及从事跟踪工作的国民党成员。

3) 安排举行示威活动（时间和地点未说明），以庆祝中苏恢复邦交。

会议由一名名为钟家俊（Tsoong Chia Tsing）的失业工人主持，他此前受雇于戈登路181号的东兴纱厂。

顾宝华
侦探长

特别巡捕房主管警官。

S2. 应提供侦缉该情报的警探姓名及线人编号。请设法获取钟家俊的照片及体貌特征描述。他居住何处？
A.D. Kuh. X分站警官 1932年12月28日。
